summary: Verified the new interactive footer wordmark and cursor trail. All required behaviours pass: per-letter distance-based spring deformation with cursor position traveling from N -> LEVEL, magnitudes strictly within limits (max |Y|=34.56, |X|=10.91, |rot|=4.55, scale=1.045), smooth return to identity at rest, LEVEL gradient renders correctly per-letter (background-clip:text, continuous gradient across 5 letters with sliced backgroundPosition), no other elements move (navbar/email/tagline bounding rects identical), cursor trail scoped to footer (opacity 1 inside, 0 outside, clipped by overflow-hidden), reduced-motion static and trail not rendered, mobile viewport keeps wordmark static. Footer design regression clean (42px rounded-top, 3 slashes, blue column headings). EVENTS dropdown = 3 items, EXPERIENCE = 5 items. Lenticular carousel arrows work. No console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: CursorTrail gates rendering on matchMedia('(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)') which correctly returns false on real touch devices. In Playwright with only a 390x844 viewport (no touch emulation), the SVG is still rendered but stays inert because no mousemove events fire. On real mobile browsers this evaluates false and the SVG is not rendered - behaviour is correct; noted only as a test-environment caveat.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Interactive wordmark uses inline style.transform per letter (span.inline-block inside [data-testid=interactive-wordmark]); parse translate3d/rotate/scale for magnitude checks. LEVEL letters use class letter-gradient with sliced backgroundSize/backgroundPosition to keep gradient continuous - verified visible during peak deformation. Cursor trail testid footer-cursor-trail is inside #footer (overflow-hidden). Prev iterations 1-5 all passed.
